camel_example: aliyun computenestsupplier ListServices --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key key1 --NextToken 'BBBAAfu+XtuBE55iRLHEYYuojI4=' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekzkt5bu0000' --Filter.1.Value.1 1 --MaxResults 10 --Tag.1.Value value1 --AllVersions false --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Filter.1.Name Status
description_en: Queries for a list of services based on specified parameters, such as a region ID and service IDs. The returned information includes the service status, service version, and publish time
description_zh: 通过指定地域ID、服务ID等参数，查询服务信息列表。例如，服务状态，服务版本，发布时间等信息
kebab_example: aliyun computenestsupplier list-services --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 10 --next-token BBBAAfu+XtuBE55iRLHEYYuojI4= --all-versions false --resource-group-id rg-aekzkt5bu0000 --filter '[{"Value":["1"],"Name":"Status"}]' --tag Value=value1 Key=key1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServices

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。其中最大值为100行，默认值为20行
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by a previous call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return all versions of the service. The default value is false. If this parameter is set to false, only the default version of each service is returned
parameters.help_zh: 返回服务的所有版本。默认值为false，对每个服务只返回默认版本
parameters.name: all_versions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

element_fields.help_en:
The name of the filter. You can query by one or more filter names. Valid values:

- ServiceId: The service ID.

- Name: The service name.

- Status: The service status.

- SupplierName: The name of the service provider
element_fields.help_zh:
过滤器名称，可选择一个或者多个名称进行查询。取值范围：

- ServiceId：服务ID。

- Name：服务名称。

- Status：服务状态。

- SupplierName：服务商名称
element_fields.name: name
